proposals.title: Proposal 4. Shareholder Proposal Seeking a Shareholder Right to Action by Written Consent
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to permit shareholders holding the minimum votes needed to act to take action by written consent on any appropriate topic.
proposals.evidence: The Board has carefully considered this proposal and unanimously recommends that you vote AGAINST it.

proposals.title: Proposal 5. Shareholder Proposal Seeking an Independent Chairman Policy
proposals.proponent: United Steelworkers, Paper and Forestry, Rubber, Manufacturing, Energy, Allied Industrial and Service Workers International Union (USW)
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to adopt a policy requiring the Chairman be an independent director who has not previously served as an executive officer of the Company.
proposals.evidence: The Board has carefully considered this proposal and unanimously recommends you vote AGAINST it.
